questions.q: Norrin Radd serves as Galactus's herald under which name?
questions.why: To spare his home world Zenn-La, Norrin Radd agreed to serve Galactus as his herald, the Silver Surfer.

questions.q: Which hero team first faces Galactus in the 'Galactus Trilogy'?
questions.why: Galactus debuted in Fantastic Four #48-50, the Galactus Trilogy.

questions.q: Galactus is known as the Devourer of what?
questions.why: Devourer of Worlds is one of his best-known aliases.

questions.q: What was Galactus called before he became Galactus?
questions.why: Galactus began as Galan, a space explorer from the planet Taa.

questions.q: In which 2007 film does Galactus appear as a non-speaking cosmic cloud?
questions.why: Galactus appears as a cosmic cloud in this 2007 Fantastic Four sequel.
Stan Lee wrote and Jack Kirby drew Galactus's debut.

questions.q: Galactus debuted with a March cover date in which year?
questions.why: Fantastic Four #48 carried a March 1966 cover date.

questions.q: On which planet was Galactus born?
questions.why: Before becoming Galactus he was a Taa-an explorer from the planet Taa in the Sixth Cosmos.

questions.q: Which herald, Frankie Raye, offered herself in exchange for Galactus sparing Earth?
questions.why: Frankie Raye became the herald Nova to spare Earth.

questions.q: Which Watcher sends the Human Torch to fetch the Ultimate Nullifier in the finale of the Galactus Trilogy?
questions.why: Uatu the Watcher sends the Torch to Taa II to retrieve the Ultimate Nullifier.
